Commentary.Commentary: Safyaan Sharif says he's excited to make a contribution. Adds that getting early wickets was the key so is happy he was able to do that. Mentions that they knew it's important to do the basics, which is partly the reason why he was able to get Chris Gayle on the very first ball of the game. States it's a great achievement for his side for putting in the kind of performance they did out on the field.

The Windies will be terribly disappointed with the way they have done with the bat. Their most important game of the competition, with the World Cup qualification on the line, and they've let themselves down. The only thing worth talking about is the 121-run partnership between Evin Lewis and Marlon Samuels (both of whom scored fifties each). Despite that stand, the scoring rate was always in check and as a result, when the wickets fell, it hurt them badly. They will have to bowl out of their skins to make something out of this. Will be a tough task. Join us in a while for the chase.

Excellent performance from the Scots with the ball. Kyle Coetzer's decision to field first has been completely justified by his bowlers. They started off in the most perfect manner, as Safyaan Sharif got Chris Gayle on the very first ball of the game, and then picked up another one to get Shai Hope. There was a big stand in between between Evin Lewis and Marlon Samuels, but they made sure they got them before they could accelerate and take the game away from them. After that stand, wickets fell at regular intervals with the spinners playing their part and ensuring the Windies didn't even reach the 200-mark.

OUT! WINDIES HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 198! Excellent delivery from Wheal to wrap things up. Fires in a yorker on leg, Paul looks to flick it away but it's too good for him. Goes off his pads and rattles the stumps behind.
Lbw appeal shut down. Fuller and angling down, which was what convinced the umpire it wasn't out. Catches Paul low on the pads as he misses his flick.
Kemar Roach is the last man in for Windies.

OUT! Carlos Brathwaite, the only man who probably had a few big hits left to hit towards the end of this innings, makes his way back slowly to the pavilion. Length ball cutting back in outside off, Brathwaite spoons a leading edge looking to put bat on ball. It goes towards George Munsey who takes a good diving catch.
Brathwaite is using that area well to his advantage. Moves inside the line and flicks it through the vacant mid-wicket area for a brace.
Brad Wheal is back.
Pushed to the covers for just the one.
Shaping back in, just ahead of a length, raps Paul on the pads as he moves across to flick. Gets caught on the pads, but the umpire doesn't respond to the lbw appeal because it was going down leg.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Works it once again, through the mid-wicket region, and gets two more.
Full and outside off, Brathwaite looks to play at it but misses.
Full delivery angling in, on the stumps, flicked through mid-wicket for a double.
Safyaan Sharif is back on.
Full and angling in on leg, closes the face early and gets a safe leading edge to backward point.
Stays inside the crease and blocks it out safely from inside the crease.
FOUR! Deft. Nicely done from Keemo Paul. He plays this really late, it's on a length around off, connects perfectly and sends it across the third man boundary.
Good length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Paul stands his ground and pushes it into the off side.
Pushes this to backward point and sets off for the run. Risky stuff, Carlos quickly sends him back. There is a shy at the striker's end which misses.
Short ball on the stumps, takes Paul by surprise who barely manages to fend it away with his gloves on the off side.
Worked away through mid-wicket for an easy run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Keemo Paul is next in.
OUT! Soft dismissal! Short of a good length outside off, Nurse walks a step across and throws everything at it. Gets an edge which spoons straight to Wheal at short third man.
Outside off on a length, Nurse pokes at it and gets a faint edge on the bounce behind to the keeper.
Works it away through point for a single.
Takes the pace off this one, full and outside off, Nurse is early into the shot as he mistimes this loft down towards long on. One run taken.
Richie Berrington to bowl out.
Short ball into the body, pulled away in front of square on the leg side for one run.
Taps this down in front of point and sets off. There is a shy at the bowler's end but the ball goes off Brathwaite's bat and deflects away.
Connects with the drive this time, but places it through mid off for a run.
Play and a miss! Full and fired just outside off, Nurse plants his front foot forward to play the cover drive but is beaten.
Another one played down to third man. Calls for the run and gets it with ease.
Outside off on a good length, Nurse looks to run this down to third man but gets a bottom edge. Not much harm done, he gets it there eventually and takes a single.
Alasdair Evans will bowl again.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket for a single.
Ashley Nurse will be the new man in.

OUT! He's chopped it back on! Sharif has his third of the game. Length ball close to off, Powell looks to play at it but there's some slight inward movement off the seam which does him in. Takes a big inside edge and then crashes into the leg pole.
Leans ahead to this full ball and knocks it down to long off. One run to the scoreboard.
Skidding off the surface outside off, looks to chop it down to third man but can't do it properly.
Full and just around off, squeezed out to point.
Length ball quite close to off, chopped down on the track towards backward point for nought.
Safyaan Sharif into the attack once more.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Some width offered outside off, on a good length, Brathwaite cuts it square past point and takes two.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Straighter in line again, it's driven down the ground, towards long on this time. One more run to the total.
Full on the stumps, driven through long off for a single.
Full and straight on the stumps, Carlos blocks it firmly back to the bowler.
Wide! False start for Wheal. It's down the leg side, the umpire signals wide.
Worked away with the spin on the leg side for a single.
A new ball is brought. The hit was so big the ball can't be found any time soon. So, a new box is brought out and the umpire picks his replacement.

SIX! What a monstrous hit! Wow. That's gone out of the park. Tossed up, right in the slot and Brathwaite holds nothing back when smoking this straight back down. Clears the roof and sends it out of the park.
Worked away through the mid-wicket area for a single.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Straighter one outside off, punched to point.
Spinning in from around off, Powell keeps it out off the back foot.
Michael Leask to bowl out.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Outside off on a bit of a fuller length, Powell pushes it to point. Brathwaite charges out for the single but is sent back just in time.
Keeps it full yet again, outside off, driven to mid off.
Fuller and outside off, tapped with an open face to point for one more.
Pitched up on the stumps, Carlos takes a step forward to drive but finds mid on.
Firmly punched, down the ground towards mid on. A quick single is taken.
Brad Wheal brought back on.
Powerplay 3 signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
On a length and angling back in on off, Brathwaite hops across to get behind the line and blocks well.
Full ball and it's driven to the covers.
Good length ball around off, Brathwaite defends well.
Carlos Brathwaite in to bat now.

OUT! What a poor shot from the skipper. Poor. Unbelievable that he of all people has done that. Short ball banged in on off, Holder goes back to pull but he's in no position to play that shot. The bounce is too big for him and as a result, he gets it off the splice towards mid-wicket. MacLeod moves to his left and takes the simplest of catches. Holder looks to the heavens, but it's Evans who smiles.
Fuller outside off, steered down to third man. One more run taken.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side for a single.
Alasdair Evans back into the attack.
Full ball on the stumps, driven to mid on to end the over.
Slower in pace and fuller outside off, a square drive from Jason Holder earns him an easy single.
Nice and full from Sharif, straight in line, it's driven back, towards mid off for nothing.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Off the splice, it's a length ball which is sliced through backward point. One run added to the total.
Full ball outside off, driven through cover. The sweeper moves to his left, fumbles which allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Works the short ball past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Backs away a bit, opens the face of the bat and steers this flat ball to point. One run taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Yorker darted on off, Powell manages to dig it out off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Quicker one on the stumps, flicked with the wrists through square leg for a single.
Dropped on a shorter length outside off, it spins back in as Holder punches this off the back foot. Along the ground through the covers and a single is earned.
Length ball on off, pushed back down the track to the bowler.
Waits for the ball to come to him, then wrists it in front of square leg and takes one.
Tucked away through mid-wicket for another single.
Driven through the covers by Jason Holder. One run added to the total.
Works this from the off stump on the leg side. Towards square leg with a flick and a run is stolen.
Angles it in on a fuller length, on the stumps, Powell closes the face slightly and drives it to mid-wicket.
Safyaan Sharif back on.
Once again worked in the same area. Dot ball to end the over.
Plays with the spin and turns it to mid-wicket. Couldn't get it wide of the fielder.
Pushes this straight to the mid off fielder.
Waits for the ball to turn in to him, goes on the back foot and eases it to long on for one.
Oooh that wasn't far away. Tossed right up there, on off, Holder chips it straight back. Barely over the bowler's head as a single is taken.
Turning in, on a driving length, Jason Holder meets it with the full face of the bat.
Into the leg side this time with the flick of the wrists. Two runs to the total.
Spinning in from outside off, Holder stands firm and chops it through covers for one run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Worked away to mid-wicket. Won't get any run for it.
Full outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Bit straight outside off, Holder plays for the turn where there isn't much. Gets beaten past the edge as the keeper takes it.
Tom Sole into the attack again.
Edged and just wide! Almost. Full outside off, Powell prods forward to defend but gets an edge past the slip fielder for a double. Excellent over from Leask, Windies in some trouble here now.
Rovman Powell is out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Beauty of a delivery from Micheal Leask! Absolute ripper. Wow. He comes from around the wicket and tosses it up on off. It drifts in at first but then spins away just enough. Shimron Hetmyer is half-forward to play at that and he nicks it behind where Matthew Cross takes it excellently in his gloves.
Jason Holder is the next man in. The skipper has been in sublime form in this tournament, his team needs him to continue that.

OUT! SAMUELS DEPARTS! Looked to up the ante and departed in the process. Flighted ball outside off, Samuels charges down and looks to clear the fence. Doesn't middle it and it's a good catch taken by Tom Sole out at wide long off. He runs to his left and pouches it well.
Misses out. Juicy full toss from Leask, Hetmyer loses his balance as he hoicks it away. Can't get much behind it, just a single to deep mid-wicket.
Short and flat, outside off, punched away to the covers for nothing.
Makes use of the feet to get close to the pitch and hits it to long off for a single.
Michael Leask returns.
On a good length and angling back in, Hetmyer hangs back and offers a punch towards mid on.
Yorker fired outside off, driven hard square of the wicket on the off side. No run taken.
Fifty for Samuels, his 30th in ODIs. Just drops this in front of covers and crosses over. He's done decently to hang in so far, maybe he'll start accelerating now. He has to for his side.
Cuts it late, down to third man and calls his partner through.
Shimron Hetmyer shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
Goes full and keeps it close to off, Shimron takes a big stride forward and drives it to cover.
Full outside off, firmly driven but straight to extra cover.
Drives a full ball to mid on and gets nothing for it.
Length ball outside off, blocked.
FOUR! Straying on the pads, easy enough for Samuels to help it on its way. A little shuffle across and the tickle which follows is enough to beat the keeper diving to his left.
Hetmyer takes it on the full, meets the ball with the full face of the blade and pushes it to covers. Single taken.
Driven down to mid on. Just the single taken.
Fullish length ball outside the line of off stump, pushed to the covers to end a successful over from Wheal.
Full delivery aiming the base of off stump, drilled to long off for a single.
Off the mark with a single down to third man. Just opens the bat face and guides it easily to the fielder positioned there.
Shimron Hetmyer to bat next.

OUT! Lewis is gone! Wheal brings about an end to the massive 121-run stand. From around the wicket, it's angled in on a fuller length, Lewis stands his ground and once again looks to go big across the line, misses and is caught flush right in front of the stumps. Loud appeal goes up and the umpire has no problem in raising his finger. Can Scotland inflict further damage from hereon?

FOUR! Streaky runs which the Windies won't mind! But the intention is clear here, Lewis is going to try and up the scoring rate. Length ball on off, the southpaw swings hard across the line and gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a boundary.
Short of a good length outside off, Marlon stands tall and slaps it through extra cover. Easy run taken by the batsmen.
Well outside off, shaping away, Evin looks to put bat on ball but fails to do so.
Moves inside the line, uses the angle and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Not much movement on this one. Length delivery in the off stump channel and it's punched through the covers easily by Lewis for a single.
Beaten! On a length on the fourth stump line, Evin Lewis attempts to cut but is beaten. There was some noise but not sure of what.
Leans a touch ahead to this length ball and pushes it into the covers for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Richie Berrington to have a go with the ball.
Hammers this full length delivery towards the long off fielder and crosses over to take strike.

Around the wicket to the left-hander, it's on a good length just around off, Lewis taps it down in front of covers and takes off. There is a shy at the bowler's end but it goes off Evin's bat, so the batsmen don't take the extra run.
Waits for the ball to come to him, it's on a length outside off, run down to third man with an open face. Single taken.
Full again, attacking the stumps, Marlon with another drive straight to mid on.
Fuller and outside the line of off stump, tapped behind square on the off side with soft hands. No run taken.
Angles in a low full toss on the stumps, Samuels off the toe end hits it straight to mid on.
Bradley Wheal back into the attack.
Dot ball to end the over. Lewis hangs deep inside his crease and keeps it out rather safely.
Punched hard to point. No run taken.
Works this away through the mid-wicket area for a run.
Short and flat outside off, punched away into the off side.
From around the wicket, it's drifting in on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Comes down the track to this tossed up ball and smacks it to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, lofted over covers for one.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
In the air for a good while but safe eventually. Cutter on a length around off, Lewis swings hard and top edges it over cover-point. It falls safely and a single is taken.
Hangs back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Extremely full and darted on off, squeezed square past point for a couple.
From around the wicket, it's a length ball angling in on off, Lewis gets behind the line and defends.
Floats it up on off, eased down to long off for a run.

A big, big appeal, especially by the keeper who is pleading as he feels Lewis is a goner. Leask bowls it quicker on the stumps, Lewis goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The players make a loud appeal and after a thought the umpire shakes his head. That was very close, there was no bat involved but it might be going over by a little. The decision there could have gone either way.
Floats it up on middle, driven down to long on for a run.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Flatter on off, defended.

NOT OUT! Samuels has his foot well inside! But a good delivery by Leask. He tosses it up outside off, it goes on with the arm and beats Samuels as he tries to play for the turn. The keeper is quick to whip the bails off and makes an appeal. The umpire goes upstairs to check and replays show that his foot is inside the crease.
A stumping appeal against Marlon Samuels has been referred upstairs.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.

100-run stand between the two. This is an excellent stand after the two early wickets. They, however, need to continue if the Windies are to get up to a big total. Another slower ball, Lewis guides it down to third man for a run.
Slower ball on off, Samuels taps it towards Kyle Coetzer at covers and sets off for a run. The Scotland skipper gets to the ball quickly, picks it up and has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Slower full ball on off, mistimed down to long off for a run. 100 up for the Windies and this partnership is now 98.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket for a run.
Fires it outside off, left alone. A good tight over, just 2 from it.
Once again plays the sweep shot which he has played with a lot of effect but this time he finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Slower through the air on off, driven through covers for a run.
Shorter in length on off, pushed through covers to bag a run.
Floats it up on off, Lewis drops it towards cover for a quick run.
Flatter on off, punched to covers.
Eased down to long off for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Back-to-back fifties for Evin Lewis, his third in this format. An important knock by the opener as he had to adjust to the situation, waited for the bad balls and has worked his way to a fine half ton. His job is not yet done though, he would look to make it big. He also gets there in style as he drives the full ball on off, over covers for a boundary.

Direct hit but the batsman was well in! On a length around off, pushed towards mid off. The batsmen set off for a run. The fielder there gets to the ball and hits bull's eye but the Marlon is well in.
Short and wide outside off, Marlon looks to cut but does not connect.
On a length around off, kept out.
Alasdair Evans is back into the attack.

A tough chance! A very tough chance you can say! The bowler gives it air on off and bowls it full. Lewis goes for the big one but gets an inside edge and the ball hits the pads of the keeper. Those need to go straight into the gloves, the keeper hardly had any time to react.
Defends the ball on off, onto the ground.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.

Ordinary fielding helps Lewis to move onto 47! Shorter in length on off, Lewis guides it towards short third man. The fielder there takes his eyes off the ball at the very last moment and it goes between his legs and the batsmen take two.
Flatter on off, Lewis tries to pierce the gap between point and backward point but can't do so as he hits it straight to the point fielder.
Flighted ball on off, Samuels with that high bat lift of his strokes it through covers for a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
FOUR! Not learning are the Scotland bowlers! Once again down the leg side, a hit-me ball. Lewis obliges as he goes down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg to move onto 45.
Shorter in length down the leg side, Samuels tries to pull but misses. The ball hits the pads and goes towards short fine leg and the batsman take a leg bye.
Sees Samuels come down the track and drags his length back. Marlon keeps it out.
Loopy ball outside off, Samuels defends it.
Comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
Shorter outside off, chopped to point.
FOUR! Swept and swept fine! Down the leg side, Lewis goes down on one knee and sweeps it through short fine leg for a boundary.
Very full on middle, driven down to long on for a run.
Worked with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Very full on middle, eased down to long on for a run.
On the stumps, blocked.

FOUR! STREAKY! Marlon won't mind though. This spoils the over however. Sole floats it up on off, turning away. Samuels goes for the expansive drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes through the first slip region for a boundary.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Eased down to long off for a run.
Very full outside off, stroked through covers for no runs.
Tosses it up on off, Marlon lunges forward and blocks it.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Fires it down the leg side. Lewis goes for the sweep but the ball hits the pads and goes towards short fine leg and the batsmen sneak a leg bye.
Fuller on off, driven to covers.
Floats it up on middle, defended.
Floats it up on off, driven through covers for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, cut through point for a run.
Michael Leask to bowl now.
OUCH! Evin Lewis is in some pain here! The physio is out with the ice bag and he is receiving some treatment.
Save your legs non-striker but he can't. A full ball outside off, Samuels bludgeons it back towards Lewis at the other end but he is unable to move out of the way and is hit on the back of his leg.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Slower through the air on the pads, worked to mid-wicket.
A low full toss on middle, eased down to long off for a run.
Flatter outside off, left alone.
Full on off, driven down to long off for a run.
Drinks break.
Back of a length on off, Lewis keeps it out. A dot to finish but a very expensive over. The best one of the innings so far.

SIX! Back-to-back maximums for Lewis. This time he goes straight. The bowler overcompensates and bowls it full on middle. Lewis gets underneath the length and lofts it straight over the bowler for a biggie. 16 from the over so far.

SIX! Just over! The third short ball on middle, Evin once again takes on the challenge of pulling it. He though does not time it that well and it goes towards deep square leg. The fielder there for a moment must have felt he has a chance as he goes running to his right. He jumps with his hands stretched above his head but the ball goes over the fence.
This time he bowls a good bouncer but Lewis lets it go.

FOUR! Short and it sat up to be hit! A bumper on middle, does not bounce as the bowler would have desired. Lewis rocks back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. The 50-run stand is up between the two. A vital one as Windies were 2/2.
On a length around off, watchfully blocked.
Floated delivery around the off stick, Samuels is forward in defense.
Back to around the wicket, pitched it full on off, a solid front foot defense is offered in response.
Tad short outside off, cut square past point. Easy double for the batsmen.
Slower through the air, well outside off, Samuels throws his bat at this but is beaten in the flight. Past the edge and into the keeper's gloves, who whips the bails off.
Over the wicket now, slightly quicker in pace, full outside off, driven hard through the covers. Two runs are taken as the fielder in the deep mops it up.
Looped up from around the wicket, it's quite full in length and slow in pace. Evin Lewis drills it back down to long on for a single.
A dot to finish but 9 from it! Fuller on middle, eased to mid on.
FOUR! Short and wide! An opportunity for Samuels and he makes full use of it. Gets on top of the bounce and cuts it over point for a boundary. An expensive over this is turning out to be.
Good length on off, Marlon quite lazily keeps it out.
Back of a length on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.

WIDE AND FOUR! Too many extras here by Scotland! This though has just taken off the surface. Short and outside off, it shoots off the pitch leaving the keeper no chance to collect it. Bonus runs for the Windies.
Just behind a length on off, Marlon defends it onto the ground.
Alasdair Evans is into the attack now.
Fires it on middle, defended.
Flatter on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Tosses it up on off, eased to covers.
Very full outside off, driven through cover-point to rotate strike.
Slows it up and floats it outside off, Lewis drives it uppishly through covers for a run. He moves onto 16.
WIDE! Third by the bowler in the number of wides he has bowled! Down the leg side and the umpire raises his arms sideways.
Tosses it up on off, hit hard but back to the bowler.
A good shot but for no runs! Fuller on off, Samuels drives it hard but straight to the fielder at mid off. Marlon is finding it very hard to score here. He is on 10 from 34 balls.
On a length around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Almost a similar ball to the last one. Samuels tries to play a similar shot but misses to get hit on the pads once again.
Goes for the yorker, the idea was good but the execution was not quite up to the mark. It is down the leg side. Samuels tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Fuller on middle, Lewis wants to drive it straight back past the bowler but gets an inside edge towards the leg side for a run.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Nicely bowled! A good one to end the over! Sole tosses it up on off, he also gets some extra bounce. Samuels tries to cut but misses.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Once again he bowls it a little too full, the spin though is out of contention due to the length. Evin drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller on off, driven to covers.
WIDE! Sole has not got it right here. He bowls it very full but down the leg side. Lewis goes to sweep but misses.
Fuller on off, driven to covers.
Wide! Down the leg side, Lewis tries to pull it fine but misses and the umpire signals a wide.
Fires it on the pads, Lewis goes to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Spin for the first time today! Tom Sole is into the attack.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of four fielders can be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Back of a length on off, blocked. End of the first Powerplay, a good one for the bowling side.

Full and wide outside off, Lewis goes hard at it as he looks to force it through the off side. The ball takes the outside edge and goes down to third man for a run. The partnership between the two moves onto 25.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Wide outside off, left alone.

BEATEN! Why was this guy removed from the attack? Creating problems immediately after being reintroduced. On a length around off, it shapes away a touch. Lewis has to play at it but is done in by the away movement as he gets beaten.

Good fielding! It was in the air for some time and there were shouts for a catch but it did not carry. Full and wide outside off, Lewis goes after it. He drives it uppishly towards cover-point. The fielder there dives to his right but the ball bounces in front of him. He, however, makes a good stop.
Safyaan Sharif is back on.
Shorter in length on off, cut to point.
Fuller on the pads, Marlon goes for the flick but misses to get hit on the pads. There is a muted appeal by the players but nothing from the umpire.
Shorter in length on middle, Marlon stands tall and pulls it through square leg. It has not been hit well enough to reach the fence but enough to get two.

Overthrow! Bonus run for the Windies. Fuller on middle, driven down to mid off. The fielder there has a needless shy at the non-striker's end. He hits the bull's eye but the batsman is well in. The ball deflects away from the man backing up and the batsmen take a run.
Back of a length on off, pushed to covers.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.

Howzaaat? The answer to that question is not out! A short ball on middle, this time it does not bounce a lot. Marlon stands tall and tries to pull but misses to get hit above the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Going over I feel.

FOUR! Uppish but in the gap, just! Back of a length on off, the bowler once again gets some extra bounce. Samuels goes back and punches it uppishly towards covers. The fielder there dives low to his left and tries to catch it but the ball is just out of his reach and it goes racing to the fence.
Wide! Once again bangs it short but too high. It is wided.
Back to bowling on a length on off, guided to point.
Wide! A bouncer on middle, good change up by the bowler. Samuels though is up for it as he ducks under it. The umpire signals it as a wide as he feels it was above the batsman's head.
Back of a length on off, kept out.

Down the leg side, Samuels fails to put it away to get hit on the thigh pad. An opportunity of scoring goes abegging there. Need to put away the bad balls here, the Windies, as there are hardly any being bowled.
On a length around off, kept out.
A dot to finish! Four from the first over of Evans. He bowls it on a length around middle, kept out.

FOUR! All the pressure built off the first four balls has been released by this poor delivery. Short and wide outside off, offers a lot of width. Lewis rocks back and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
On a length around off, driven towards covers. 4 dots to begin with.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Bowls it outside off, Lewis lets it be.

A huge appeal! A very good start by the bowler! He pitches it around the leg stump and gets it to angle away. Lewis tries to drive but misses to get hit on the pads. The players make an appeal but the umpire stays put. Hawk Eye later on shows it to be pitching outside leg.
Alasdair Evans is into the attack. First change of today.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it on the pads. Samuels tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head as it would have been missing leg.
Fuller on off and angling into the batsman. Marlon gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it.
Back of a length on off, blocked.
Bowls it on a length around off, giving no room to the batsman. All he can do is keep it out.
On off and on a length. Samuels is solid in defense.
On a length, attacking the stumps. Samuels keeps it out.
Errs in line and bowls it down the leg side. It has been wided.

Just ahead of a length around off, shapes in a touch. Lewis tries to drive but the ball takes the inside edge and hits him on his pads. He removes his pad as he looks in a little pain. The physio is also out to have a look.
Goes back to bowling length outside off. Lewis lets it be.
FOUR! Don't bother running for that! A full ball outside off, by Sharif, the first bad ball by him. Lewis pounces on it and strokes it through extra covers for a boundary. the first for the game.
On middle, flicked through square leg for a run.
On a length around middle, pushed towards wide mid on for an easy run.
Works it around the corner with the angle for a run.
A single to end the over as Marlon guides it down to third man for a run.
Good bowling! Bends his back on this one and lands it on a length. Gets it to bounce extra. Samuels first thinks of playing at it but then lets it be.
Back of a length on off, guided to point.
WIDE! Down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Angles it into the batsman. Samuels tries to flick but closes the face of the bat a little early. It takes a soft leading edge towards covers.

Extra bounce! The ball is doing a lot out there. Wheal lands it on a length around off, the ball shoots off the surface. Samuels goes to defend but is surprised by the bounce. He though does well to take his hand off the handle and defend it onto the ground.
Fuller on middle, Samuels tries to drive but gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a run. He gets off the mark.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
This was very wide outside off, Marlon makes a leave.

OOOO! Excellent delivery! On a length around off, moving away. Samuels has this habit of poking at the balls outside the off stump. He does that but unlike Hope and Gayle, the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Marlon Samuels is the next man in.

OUT! Sharif strikes on the first ball of his second over also! He is breathing fire out there. Once again the perfect outswinger to Hope. He first angles it in on off and then gets it to shape away. Hope is drawn into playing at it as he pokes at it away from his body. The ball kisses the outside edge and the keeper does the rest. Hope walks back dejected. He too bags a duck and the Scots are all over the Windies here.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Just ahead of a length on off, driven to covers.
First runs for the Windies and it is off the bat of Evin Lewis. Fuller and swinging back into the batsman. He flicks it through mid-wicket and bags a brace.
On a length around off, pushed to covers.
Another delivery outside off, Lewis lets it be.
Good ball to start off! On a length close to the off stump but not close enough for the batsman to play at it.
Bradley Wheal will bowl from the other end.
Fuller on off, driven to mid off. End of a wicket maiden. Outstanding over.
On a length around off, kept out.
Bowls it outside off, Hope lets it be.
BEATEN! Excellent bowling! He lands it on a length around off, once again it moves away from the batsman. Hope pokes at it and gets beaten.
Good second delivery! On a length around off, shapes away a touch. Hope lets it be.
Shai Hope is the next man in. There is a short leg in place for him.

OUT! Yes, he can! He does it off the very first ball! It has been edged and taken. What a start, what a start for Scotland! You could not bowl a better ball to Chris Gayle first up. Safyaan Sharif comes running in and lands it on a length on off, it shapes in at first but then straightens a touch. Gayle tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes into the mitts of the keeper who takes it easily. They appeal and up goes the finger. The Scottish are ecstatic as they have got the big fish. Chris bags a golden duck and it is a dream beginning to a game which has so much on stake for the bowling side.

We are done and dusted with the national anthems and we are all set for this very, very important game to begin. The dynamic duo of Chris Gayle and Evin Lewis make their way out to the middle as they will be opening the batting for the Windies. Safyaan Sharif will open the bowling for Scotland. Can he get an early breakthrough? The Scottish will surely hope so. He has two slips in place. Here we go...
PITCH REPORT - Lisa Sthalekar says the pitch is being used for the first time. informs the good length area has a little bit more grass than the other areas.

Windies skipper, Jason Holder, says they wanted to bat first. Opines it is a fresh pitch and it might provide some assistance to the bowlers up front. Reckons all the teams are under pressure as all the games are must-win games. Informs they have made one change as Carlos Brathwaite comes in for Devendra Bishoo.

Scotland skipper, Kyle Coetzer, says it is a big game and a big occasion for them. Adds they have to believe and put in a strong performance. He feels the wicket looks good as it is a fresh one. States they would look to put the Windies under pressure by taking early wickets. Mentions they will look to go out there and play their game. Kyle Coetzer has mentioned two changes, but there are in fact three - Michael Jones, Alasdair Evans and Tom Sole come in.
TOSS - Scotland win the toss and will have a bowl first!

We are now into the business end of the qualifiers with only three games left before the final. The race for securing a World Cup spot intensifies as Scotland face the Windies today in Harare. A potential semi-final as the loser today will see themselves being knocked out. The men from the Caribbean head into this fixture as big favourites but one cannot rule the Scottish out, especially after the cricket they have played throughout. Both the teams will be giving it their all and we can surely hope for an exciting encounter. Hello and welcome to the coverage.
